items.flagged_in_journal: usage_wrong #1 「入り口から外へ出てください。」 is perfectly acceptable, natural Japanese: exiting through the entrance is a real instruction actually used (e.g. when the exit is crowded or blocked), and 入り口 keeps its correct meaning. An acceptable use, so the item fails.
